novel_mechanics_found: Level 4 has a color-8 sliding blocker whose right endpoint is entered at player top-left (32,26): occupation shifts the blocker one six-cell quantum and clears the left shaft, but it snaps back as soon as the body leaves, requiring a committed clone holder. The color-15 paired rail sockets are clone-selective: a live body entering the upper socket at (26,38) remains there, while a replaying clone that enters it and then executes RIGHT is rerouted to the lower parallel socket at (26,50). Inputs that have no movement effect do not reliably advance clone replay, so successful movement is the usable replay clock. After both clone slots have been used, ACTION5 clears the clones and rewinds to the level spawn but does not restore the level timer.
narrative: Resolved and replayed the registry prefix from a genuinely fresh environment: all 118 labels used exactly 118 env.step calls and the rendered frame confirmed levels_completed=3. I mapped level 4 through frames and two live clone programs, discovering the pressure-held color-8 door and the clone-only color-15 reroute. A corrected 154-action full candidate attempted to hold the blocker, route a second clone into the lower goal corridor, and clock that clone onto the goal; the mandatory fresh-reset reproduction gate reached only level 3 (reproduced=false for claimed level 4). I stopped at 557 total calls because another fresh-prefix attempt plus verification could not fit under the 600-step cap; no level-4 win was observed live or reproduced.
gotchas: The 118-action resolver prefix was replayed on a fresh env and reached levels_completed=3 exactly; it consumed one env.step per label in this session.
The color-8 blocker only stays shifted while a body occupies its right endpoint at player top-left (32,26); leaving the endpoint closes the left shaft immediately.
Blocked/no-effect actions did not continue advancing an already committed clone during live probing; use successful oscillating moves as the replay clock.
The upper color-15 socket behaves differently for the live body and a replaying clone: RIGHT is a live no-op there, but the same recorded RIGHT rerouted the clone from (26,38) to (26,50).
ACTION5 after two commits clears both ghosts and rewinds the active body to spawn, but the depleted bottom-row timer is preserved, so it is not a full retry.

The final fresh-reset candidate routed a clone toward the lower goal but did not win; a clone on the goal is insufficient by itself, or the reroute/replay timing needs an additional active-body interaction.
